name: X (formerly Twitter)
tagline: Real-time public conversation app, now part of SpaceX's xAI unit
facts: 2006 as Twitter; renamed X in Jul 2023
Musk bought 2022 ($44B); merged into xAI Mar 2025
SpaceX acquired xAI Feb 2026; SPCX listed Jun 2026
Musk; no CEO since Yaccarino quit Jul 2025

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Be the global town square and, per Musk, the 'everything app' for content, payments and AI.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: Super-app combining posts, video, Grok AI, X Money payments and trading via Smart Cashtags.

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: Less dependence on brand ads; subscriptions (Premium), creator payouts, data and distribution for Grok.

strategy.label: AI flywheel
strategy.text: X posts train and ground Grok; Grok lives inside X, driving engagement and Premium upsell.

strategy.label: Lesson
strategy.text: Mass layoffs and moderation cuts kept product alive but brand-safety exodus halved ad revenue.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Is X now a data asset for xAI rather than a standalone social product, and does that matter?

customers.pain: Need real-time information and direct audience reach
customers.why: Fastest breaking news, open graph, Community Notes
Revenue sharing for Premium creators, subscriptions, long posts and video

customers.who: Heavy users wanting verification and Grok
customers.pain: Want reach boost, fewer ads, AI tools
customers.why: Checkmark, reply prioritisation, Grok access, edit and longer posts

customers.pain: Brand safety concerns and weaker measurement
customers.why: Cheap CPMs, unique live-event audience, Grok-powered ad tools

rows.how: Promoted posts and video ads, auction CPM
Tiered fees via app stores and web
Paid API tiers; data feeds Grok training

rows.who_uses: US users sending and spending money

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: 2025 est. ~$3.3B from ads and subs (Sacra); ads now well below $4.5B 2021 peak.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: ~550M claimed MAU; small paying Premium base; advertisers concentrated in performance budgets.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: ~80% headcount cut lowered costs; but xAI lost $6.4B on $3.2B revenue in 2025.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: Grok bundling, X Money, Smart Cashtag trading, video, winning back brand advertisers.

friction: Bots, spam and reply-guy Premium accounts in replies
Brand-safety concerns keep major advertisers away
Paid verification makes checkmarks less trustworthy
Frequent rule and feature changes confuse users
Perceived political bias pushes users to Threads, Bluesky

competitors.label: AI assistants
competitors.text: ChatGPT, Gemini, Meta AI vs Grok

competitors.label: Payments
competitors.text: Venmo, Cash App, PayPal, Robinhood for trading

competitors.label: Edge
competitors.text: Unmatched real-time news graph plus Musk reach plus xAI compute

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: Ad decline, EU DSA fines, Grok content controversies, key-person risk
